note:
Trial 3 ended in death.

**Outcome:** The screen shows "TRIAL END: DEATH" with the chat line "angelasq was shot by Pillager". The lone visible hostile was a crossbow pillager perched on top of a tree directly ahead of the spawn point. It was never reached or hit.

**What happened:**
- The player spawned facing a stone ledge with the pillager elevated on the tree canopy. Forward and forward-left movement, including a jump, did not visibly change position, so the ledge appeared to block the approach.
- Health fell from full to half a heart over four screenshots while trying to close distance. The pillager fired steadily from above.
- Raising the shield while facing the pillager did not visibly stop the damage, probably because the bolts were coming from a steep upward angle and the view was not tilted up enough until the final action.
- The last action tilted the view up with the shield held, but the fatal bolt landed before it took effect.

**Input problems:** No command errors. The main issue was ineffective movement, with the character seemingly stuck against the stone block in front of spawn for several actions while under fire.
